caption: Palazzo dei Consoli, Gubbio
composition: Gothic palace above Piazza Grande · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist faces the Palazzo dei Consoli from the broad Piazza Grande, its crenellated Gothic stone mass filling the left and center of the frame. A pointed arched portal opens below rows of mullioned windows, and the external staircase climbs along the right side toward the lower roofs of the town. The 07:50 sun warms the pale stone under a bright blue sky, with the wooded hillside and Gubbio's rooftops falling away to the right.
